data.name: Candlewood Suites Queretaro Juriquilla by IHG
data.address: Santa Teresa 502 Int. A Fracc. Residencial Juriquilla, Santa Fé, 76226 Santiago de Querétaro, Qro., Mexico
data.description:
Opposite the Superama Juriquilla supermarket and next to the Plaza Ubika shopping mall, this laid-back, all-suite hotel in a residential neighborhood is 8 km from Parque Bicentenario and 36 km from Querétaro International Airport.
The understated, warmly decorated suites feature sitting areas, dining spaces, and kitchens with fridges, stoves and microwaves. All have free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. The 1-bedroom suites add separate living rooms. Kids stay at no extra cost with an adult.
Parking is complimentary. Other amenities include BBQ grills, picnic tables and coin-operated laundry facilities, along with a gym and an outdoor pool.
